safety_notes: Leaf margins have sharp silica micro-teeth; wear gloves when handling.

common_pests_and_diseases.name: Red Rot (Colletotrichum falcatum)
common_pests_and_diseases.symptoms: Third or fourth leaf from top yellows and withers; cane split open shows red internal pith with white transverse patches and alcoholic smell
common_pests_and_diseases.management: Set treatment with Carbendazim (1 g/L); use tissue-cultured healthy setts; cultivate resistant Co 0238 / Co 86032

common_pests_and_diseases.name: Early Shoot Borer (Chilo infuscatellus)
common_pests_and_diseases.symptoms: Dead hearts in young tillers; dead heart emits foul odor when pulled
common_pests_and_diseases.management: Trash mulching; release Trichogramma chilonis egg parasitoid (50,000/ha)

prevention_guidance: Select disease-free certified seed nursery setts
Adopt drip fertigation to conserve 40% water
Practice trash mulching between cane rows

Ret bundles in slow-flowing clean water for 12–15 days

leaf_characteristics.shape: Lower leaves pinnatifid lyrate with large terminal lobe; upper leaves lanceolate entire

stem_characteristics: Erect branched succulent stem with glaucous bloom, 1.0–2.0 meters
flower_characteristics: Terminal racemes of bright golden-yellow 4-petaled cruciform flowers
fruit_characteristics: Slender cylindrical 2-valved silique pod with ascending beak holding small round brown seeds
growth_habit: Erect branched annual herb, 1.0–2.0 meters
habitat_and_climate: Cool winter climate with clear bright sunshine; sensitive to heavy frost and cloudy weather

common_pests_and_diseases.name: Mustard Aphid (Lipaphis erysimi)
common_pests_and_diseases.symptoms: Dense colonies suck sap from inflorescences and pods, curling leaves and reducing seed yield
common_pests_and_diseases.management: Foliar spray of Dimethoate 30 EC (1 ml/L) or Imidacloprid 17.8 SL (0.25 ml/L)

common_pests_and_diseases.name: White Rust (Albugo candida)
common_pests_and_diseases.symptoms: Prominent creamy white pustules (blisters) on lower leaf surfaces; floral malformation
common_pests_and_diseases.management: Spray Mancozeb (2 g/L) or Metalaxyl

prevention_guidance: Sow before October 20 to escape peak aphid infestation in January
Maintain 30x10 cm spacing

prevention_guidance: Sow on raised beds to ensure rapid surface drainage
Harvest when bottom capsules start turning yellow to avoid shattering
